Alignment of sequencing reads and processing into a digital gene expression matrix was performed using Cell Ranger version 4.0.0, including the aligner STAR version 2.5.1b, with standard parameters. The -expect-cells parameter was set to 6,000–21,250 based on the number of cells loaded per sample (62.5% of cells loaded). The data was aligned against GRCz11 release 99 (January 2020) using the Lawson Lab Zebrafish Transcriptome Annotation version 4.3.2, published in Lawson et al. eLife 2020, available from https://www.umassmed.edu/lawson-lab/reagents/zebrafish-transcriptome/. 320 entries annotated as pseudogenes by Ensembl were removed from the reference.
Assembly: GRCz11 release 99 (January 2020), Lawson Lab Annotation v 4.3.2 (https://www.umassmed.edu/lawson-lab/reagents/zebrafish-transcriptome/)

The -expect-cells parameter was set to 6,000–21,250 based on the number of cells loaded per sample (62.5% of cells loaded). The data was aligned against GRCz11 release 99 (January 2020) using the Lawson Lab Zebrafish Transcriptome Annotation version 4.3.2, published in Lawson et al. eLife 2020, available from https://www.umassmed.edu/lawson-lab/reagents/zebrafish-transcriptome/. 320 entries annotated as pseudogenes by Ensembl were removed from the reference.
Assembly: GRCz11 release 99 (January 2020), Lawson Lab Annotation v 4.3.2 (https://www.umassmed.edu/lawson-lab/reagents/zebrafish-transcriptome/)
